div.head: Northu 2.2
div.ab: ⁊ gilde se þe woh dide XX ór þam biscope, XII ór þam preoste, þe he of his circan asette, XII ór eallum geferan, ⁊ þolige þæs feos eac, gif he on unriht ænig for oðres preostes circan sealde.
And gilde se þe woh dide XX or þam biscope, XII or þam preoste þe he of his circan asette, XII or eallum geferan, and þolige þæs feos eac gif he on unriht ænig for oðres preostes circan sealde.

Und der, welcher das Unrecht beging, zahle 20 Ör dem Bischofe, 12 Ör dem Pfarrer, den er aus dessen Kirche entfernt hat, 12 Ör allen Genossen und verliere auch das Geld, wenn er widerrechtlich etwas für die Kirche [jenes] anderen Pfarrers gezahlt hat.

And let him who did the wrong pay 20 ores to the bishop, 12 ores to the priest whom he removed from his church, 12 ores to all the fellows, and let him also lose the money, if he wrongfully paid anything for [that] other priest's church.

And he who did that wrong is to pay 20 ores to the bishop, 12 ores to the priest whom he ousted from his church, 12 ores to all the colleagues, and he is also to forfeit the money if he gave any wrongly for the church of another priest.

And he who committed that offense is to pay twenty oras to the bishop, twelve oras to the priest whom he displaced from his church, and twelve oras to all of his colleagues, and he is also to forfeit the payment if he paid anything wrongfully for another priest’s church.
div.note: D reads ‘ór ⁊ þ.’; the scribe first wrote ‘XX ór ⁊ þ. b. XX ór; þ. p. … XII ór ⁊ eal.’, then erased the second ‘⁊’ and corrected the second XX to XII, but left the first ‘⁊’ and the punctuation before ‘þ. p.’.
oras: The ora was a unit of coinage equal to sixteen pence or one-fifteenth of a pound.
